defect.baseline: 0.1.0.dev7 rejects the valid wrapped relative CS entry before native process launch
defect.change: Normalize relative MZ entry and 16-bit CS relocation, then require the observed unmasked physical entry to match the unwrapped allocation. Offline identity uses the same normalized entry.
defect.preserved: Existing actual A20, allocation, stack, ownership and source-byte checks

primary_loader_evidence.contract: EXE CS+load segment passes to RealMake(uint16_t,uint16_t), then Real2Phys adds segment*16 and offset without an A20 mask

final_focused_suite.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_native_session_wrapped_entry.py tests/test_standalone_native_runtime.py tests/test_inspection.py tests/test_backend.py tests/test_kit.py --tb=short

verification.independent_review: No blocking findings; source diff and authored regression cases reviewed against loader semantics

runtime.input_surface: Isolated headless native diagnostic using installed dotbox.native_session.NativeSession; no desktop input or outer takeover qualification

startup_enter.effect: Original copyright prompt -> hardware/input/memory screen -> Ready - Press a Key
